in_sanskrit.name: Tehvansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Blessing
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Tehvansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Tehvansh means 'God's Blessing'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Tejas', which means 'Radiance'. The name signifies the divine blessings and protection of the gods, bestowing prosperity, success and good fortune upon the child. It is a powerful name that invokes the blessings of the divine and is believed to bring happiness and prosperity to the family.
